title: Autonomous investigation of Pt substitution effects on HMF surface reorientation
difficulty_reasons: Requires planning and prioritizing a broad multi-start H2/HMF adsorption and transition-path search across two metallic surfaces.
The agent must independently discriminate the direction of Pt effects and justify coverage and stopping without an author-route hint.
